issue.title: Capture lists under a lone @file header
issue.description: A capture item whose first line is only `@file` (or `@file#section`) files each bullet below it as its own new task (or section note) in that file. A trailing ` :` or ` ^` on a task bullet, or on one of its nested bullets, opens a block-ID prompt for that task with a default ID Bryan is likely to accept, and ` :<id>` also links the task into today's daily note. Execution, `capture-parse`, `capture-complete`, the dry-run preview, and Bob Mac Capture always agree.
